description: VLS Choletbus 2 Roues Cholet is a dataset listed in transport.data.gouv.fr, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Transports Publics du Choletais. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-france-transport-data-gouv-national-access-point.
